title: leucanthemum cacuminis
intro: Leucanthemum cacuminis, commonly known as Alpine Daisy, is a flowering plant species. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress, improve digestion, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Leucanthemum cacuminis include antiseptic, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which can aid in wound healing, muscle relaxation, and respiratory relief. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
